steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "6727"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('6', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('7', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('2', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('7', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
Then I should see the employee "Alexis" in the employee list
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
When I add the "Acrylic removal" service to my cart
Then I should see the service "Acrylic removal" in my cart
When I select the service "Acrylic removal" in my cart
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
When I select the "GIFT CARD" category
Then I should see the "Gift card $50" service
When I add the "Gift card $50" service to my cart
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Activate Gift Card $50.00"
And I click on the "OK" button in the popup dialog
Then I should see my cart showing 2 item added
And I should see the service "Gift card $50 (2003)" in my cart
When I pay the exact amount by "Cash"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')

Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'OK', exact: true })
Expect "toBeHidden" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
When I select the "CLOSED TICKET" tab
Then I should see the first ticket of payment "$75.7"
When I reopen ticket with payment amount "$75.7"

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$75.7' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$75.7' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()

Click locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$75.7' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
And I should see the user info "Alexis" in the ticket
When I select the service "Gift card $50 (2003)" in my cart
And I select the "VOID ITEM" on the menu
Then I should see my cart showing 1 item added
When I click on the "Pay" button
Then I should see the payment history "Cash $75.70 " visible
When I select the payment history "Cash $75.70 "
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Cash  - $75.70"
When I click on the "Remove" button in the popup dialog
When I select the "Cash" payment type
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Close Ticket"
And I should see a popup dialog with content "CHANGE$0.00OK"
When I click on the "OK" button in the popup dialog
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
Given I am on the GIFT_CARD_BALANCE page
Then I should see the text "Gift Card / Loyalty Balance" visible
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Gift Card / Loyalty Balance', { exact: true })
Then I should see a popup dialog containing the title "ACTIVATE GIFT CARD"
And I should see a popup dialog with content "Do you want to activate gift card #2003"
